headline: United's operation is calm, with its hubs running normally today.

items.text: All seven United hubs reporting so far today are at 86% on time or better, and no FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any of them.
The network disruption index is 15.1, in the normal range under 20, and weather is not affecting operations at any of the nine United hubs with a current report.

These are watches, not problems: the FAA's operations plan says a ground stop or ground delay program is possible for flights into Newark (EWR) tomorrow after 10:00 AM ET, and a ground delay program is possible for flights into San Francisco (SFO) tomorrow after 9:00 AM PT. Neither is in effect.
